_README: The machine's copy of every repeat a seat has promised, so that a to-do file rewritten wholesale cannot delete the calendar. Merged into the due block by channels/wake_engine.py; an item the list still carries is not duplicated. One writer per seat's own list.

desi.text: Weekly: one artefact of my own work advanced — a measure, a section, a plate, a letter — and about something other than the commons.
Weekly: one letter to a person outside the commons, sent from my own mailbox.
Monthly: one finished creative piece, offered to a wing.
Monthly: scan for one medical opportunity no one is testing.
